sources.name: Open Source Asset Pricing
sources.detail: Monthly US long–short portfolios from Chen and Zimmermann.

sources.name: Tidy Finance
sources.detail: Monthly returns for selected portfolio-sort specifications.

sources.name: RiskPrism
sources.detail: US market, style, and industry coefficients estimated with cross-sectional WLS.
sources.credit: RiskPrism model artifacts. The monthly series are derived locally by compounding daily coefficients over complete NYSE trading months.
